action.objective: Verify Qxf3 as the check evasion, keeping material and avoiding the knight fork on e1.
action.rationale: Broad search clearly favors d1f3 (129 exact, depth 2), while g1h1/g1f1 lose the rook on e1 to Nxe1 and g2f3 is only an upper bound at 86. Need single-candidate verification of d1f3 for immediate mates and tactical refutations before committing.
